title: WM004 weather parameters: what can be read, and what the observed record supports
project: WA-PSD-PLN-05 Rain Emergency Response Plan, WM004 console, weather channel
statusLabels: Station and aviation reports: Reported. Counts, percentiles, shares and contingency tables: Recomputed. Model output for the hours ahead: Model forecast (Proposed). Model hours before now and the reanalysis: Model analysis (Recomputed). Every threshold: Proposed. NCM wording: Reported, official. A missing value is no reading, never zero and never calm.
findings: All 19 hourly variables and 7 daily variables can be read. Open-Meteo answered all 56 calls (8 rain points, best_match and 6 models), 23.1 KB a call, and every variable is present in 100 percent of the next 72 hours in best_match. 16 variables are present in at least five of the six other models, so an ensemble band (3 or more independent models) can be drawn for them: temperature, apparent temperature, humidity, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, gust, pressure_msl, surface_pressure, four cloud covers, CAPE, rain probability and weather code. visibility, soil moisture and uv_index cannot carry a band (best_match plus one or two models). meteofrance_seamless ends on 28 Oct 22:00. The raw files are too large for the console (about 1.3 MB for 7 models and 8 points): bake the current hour and compact 72 h series, fetch the rest at run time.

Do not let these set a level: model visibility (best_match found 7 of 85 METAR hours below 5 km at OMRK in 92 days; gfs_seamless stays at 24.1 km; ukmo_seamless never goes below 5 km), CAPE in J/kg (the models differ by a factor of 3, meteofrance_seamless reads about 0, three models exceed 8,000, and the 6 thunder hours at OMFJ show no rise), gfs_seamless gust (below its own wind speed in 58 percent of hours) and meteofrance_seamless humidity (14 to 17 points low at OMRK and OMFJ). Show them, with the model named.

Station layer: aviationweather.gov JSON and the IEM archive both carry temperature, dew point, wind, visibility, pressure, cloud and weather. Gusts are in only 0.2, 0.1 and 0.7 percent of reports at OMRK, OMSJ and OMFJ, so no gust means no gust reported, never calm; IEM mslp is empty, so pressure comes from the Q group; a call to aviationweather.gov returns at most 400 reports. The IEM record has a 50 day hole, 4 Mar to 23 Apr 2026, which holds the 21 to 27 Mar spell: no threshold was tested on it.

Air quality is complete (dust, pm10, pm2_5 in ug/m3, aerosol optical depth), but the 8 points give only 5 distinct series and CAMS history starts on 4 Aug 2022. It does not separate the dust hours the airports reported from its own background (the alert level of 500 ug/m3 catches 3 of 10, 4 of 21 and 2 of 26 observed Oct to Mar episodes). Marine is complete at 25.80, 55.85 (served from 25.79, 55.79) and reads open water sea state only, with no tide or surge; it is lower than the NCM wording and is display only. The archive has all 389 days at both points; ERA5 ends on 18 Oct 2026, so the last six days are provisional.

The pressure rule as written, a fall of 3 hPa in 3 h, cannot be used: 95.2, 96.3 and 96.3 percent of such falls are between 13:00 and 15:00 (the afternoon pressure tide) and it fires on 125 episodes a season at OMRK with no rain signal. A 24 h fall of 4 hPa or more, or a tide adjusted 3 h fall of 2 hPa, carries a weak one (rain within 12 h after 16 to 24 percent of flagged hours against 3 to 6 percent of all hours).

A model gust is not a METAR gust. The reanalysis gust reaches the same days a season at 54, 53 and 47 km/h (OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ) as the METAR peak does at 40 km/h, so the forecast gust thresholds are 10 km/h above the observed ones (watch 50, alert 60 against 40 and 50). The gust thresholds are the weakest in this set and need a season of recorded forecasts and a site anemometer.

plausibility.bounds: late October, northern UAE: temperature 8 to 48, dew point minus 8 to 30, RH 3 to 100, wind 0 to 90, gust 0 to 150, pressure_msl 990 to 1030, CAPE 0 to 6,000, uv 0 to 13, soil moisture 0 to 0.6, valid WMO codes only

verdictByVariable.temperature_2m: Plausible in every model. Against METAR over 92 days best_match is within 0.4 deg C on average and 1.0 to 1.7 deg C absolute; meteofrance_seamless reads 2.1 deg C warm at OMRK.
verdictByVariable.apparent_temperature: Plausible; follows temperature and humidity. Display only.
verdictByVariable.relative_humidity_2m: Plausible. The models differ by 28 points on average in the next 72 h. Against METAR best_match is 1 to 5 points off on average (absolute 7 to 13); meteofrance_seamless reads 14 to 17 points low at OMRK and OMFJ.
verdictByVariable.dew_point_2m: Plausible, never above the temperature. ecmwf_ifs025 and icon_seamless are the closest to METAR (absolute 1.6 to 2.2 deg C at the west stations); gfs_seamless reads 2 to 3 deg C dry at all three stations and meteofrance_seamless 3 to 4 deg C dry at OMRK and OMFJ.
verdictByVariable.wind_speed_10m: Plausible. The models read 2 to 3 km/h under the METAR mean wind at the three stations (best_match bias minus 3.1, minus 2.3, minus 3.2 km/h).
verdictByVariable.wind_direction_10m: Plausible. Absolute error 18 to 32 deg for best_match when the METAR wind is 10 km/h or more; ukmo_seamless 53 deg at OMRK.
verdictByVariable.wind_gusts_10m: Plausible except gfs_seamless, whose gust is under its own wind speed in 1,010 of 1,728 hours. A model gust is a different quantity from a METAR gust, which is reported only when it is 10 kt above the mean.
verdictByVariable.pressure_msl: Plausible and the best read of all: best_match is within 0.3 to 0.8 hPa of the METAR Q group and every model correlates above 0.97. The largest biases are at OMFJ (ecmwf_ifs025 plus 1.4, meteofrance_seamless plus 2.1 hPa), which does not matter for a tendency.
verdictByVariable.surface_pressure: Plausible; follows the height of the grid cell (Jebel Jais cell 770 m reads about 928 hPa, Showkah 616 m). Not for tendency across points: use pressure_msl.
verdictByVariable.cloud_cover: Plausible, 0 to 100 percent. No observed cloud amount is read here, so it is shown, not triggered.
verdictByVariable.visibility: Present in best_match, gfs_seamless and ukmo_seamless only and without skill: median 22 km against a METAR median of 10 km (METAR is capped at 10 km); best_match found 7 of 85 METAR hours below 5 km at OMRK; gfs_seamless stays at 24.1 km. Shown, never a trigger.
verdictByVariable.cape: Not comparable across models and not plausible at the top: ukmo_seamless reaches 13,610 J/kg, ecmwf_ifs025 9,150 and best_match 8,750 in the 92 days; meteofrance_seamless reads about 0. Thunder hours at OMFJ show no rise in CAPE.
verdictByVariable.precipitation_probability: Plausible, 0 to 73 percent in the next 72 h. Not from meteofrance_seamless.
verdictByVariable.weather_code: Only valid WMO codes appear (0 to 95). In the next 72 h ukmo_seamless shows 95 (thunderstorm), gem_seamless 80 (showers), ecmwf_ifs025 and gfs_seamless 51 (drizzle).
verdictByVariable.soil_moisture_0_to_7cm: Plausible for a dry desert surface: 0.03 to 0.05 m3/m3. Two models only.
verdictByVariable.uv_index: Plausible: peak 6.45 on 22 Oct. Two models only (best_match, gfs_seamless).

modelHoursAgainstMetar92Days.note: model hours at the station coordinates against the METAR sample nearest HH:00, 24 Jul to 24 Oct 2026 (a summer to autumn sample: it says little about the Oct to Mar wind regime)

airQuality.horizon: the request asked for 5 forecast days and 2 past days (168 hours, 22 Oct 00:00 to 28 Oct 23:00): 98 hours remain after 22:00 on 24 Oct
airQuality.plausibility: Plausible for the region: across the 8 points from 24 Oct 22:00 to 28 Oct 23:00 dust runs 3 to 721 ug/m3, pm10 31.8 to 502.9, pm2_5 15.4 to 91.7 and aerosol optical depth 0.21 to 0.60; a background pm2_5 of 20 to 40 ug/m3 and an optical depth of 0.2 to 0.5 are ordinary for the UAE. Show with the units.
airQuality.history: CAMS global history starts on 4 Aug 2022 04:00 local (earlier dates return nothing); no gaps after that.

marine.verdict: Available and complete (all four variables, 168 of 168 hours, 100 percent of the next 72 h) at every point tried. Plausible: Gulf points 0.18 to 0.46 m, wave period 3 to 5 s from 273 to 344 deg (a short wind sea), sea surface temperature 31.2 to 32.4 deg C; the Oman Sea point 0.16 to 0.28 m with a 6.5 to 11.4 s swell from 93 to 119 deg and 31.1 to 31.7 deg C. The request for 25.80, 55.85 is served from the cell 25.79, 55.79; the product has no tide and no storm surge, and its cells are about 0.083 deg (9 km) wide, so it reads open water sea state only, not the shoreline. It is lower than the NCM wording (slight to moderate in the Gulf): not reconciled, owner NCM marine. Display only; the plan has no sea state trigger.

iemArchive.recordHole: no observations from 4 Mar 2026 13:00 to 23 Apr 2026 17:00 at all three stations (50 days, 34, 86 and 86 hours in March, none from 21 to 31 Mar): the heaviest spell on the register cannot be checked against stations. Owner: the IEM archive and, upstream, the airport weather offices through NCM.
iemArchive.cleaningNote: wind is read from the report text only (a group such as 100074KT is a typing error and is dropped, never read from the IEM column); a Q value outside 960 to 1050 is replaced by the A group when that is sane; a single hour that is 4 hPa, 7 deg C or 8 deg C off both neighbours is removed; duplicate station times are merged. Counted by the engine as what the report says, no value is estimated.
iemArchive.definitions: Fog hour: FG, BCFG, MIFG, PRFG or FZFG (not VCFG) or visibility of 1,000 m or less (a METAR 1000 m converts to 998 m in IEM miles). Counts to Mar 2026 on this wording: OMRK 166, OMSJ 192, OMFJ 6 (FG alone 139, 187, 0); calibration.json counts 151, 190, 0: not reconciled, and no threshold here depends on the difference. Dust hour: DU, BLDU, DRDU, SA, DS, SS. Rain hour: RA, DZ, SH or TS (not VC). Peak wind: the higher of the mean and a reported gust in the hour. Season: Oct to Mar, seven full seasons 2019 to 2020 up to 2025 to 2026 plus 1 to 24 Oct 2026 in the distributions; days per season divide by the seven full seasons.

stations.ncmAutomaticStations: NCM publishes 87 automatic stations (26 inside 24.9 to 26.2 N, 55.5 to 56.5 E) with dry temperature, wind, pressure, humidity, radiation, visibility (2 of 87 stations), precipitation and soil moisture every 15 minutes, but the page is token gated and is not read. No rain gauge register is on file. Owner: Wet Utilities with NCM.

modelEquivalence.note: ERA5 hourly at the station coordinates, Oct to Mar 2019 to 2026 (days with at least 20 observed hours). The reanalysis gust is far above the METAR peak, so a forecast gust threshold has to be higher than the observed one; the table gives the reanalysis value that fires on as many days as each observed level.

thresholds.parameter: wind speed, sustained (hourly mean at 10 m)

forecast.source: wind_speed_10m, median of the usable models (Model forecast, Proposed); the reanalysis equivalent of the station values, see modelEquivalence

thresholds.basis: Watch sits at the 99th percentile of Oct to Mar hours at the two west stations (OMRK 29.6 km/h, OMSJ 31.5 km/h; OMFJ 40.7 km/h is the windy east coast). Alert is the 99.9th percentile. NCM wording for the next days is 10 to 25 km/h reaching 35 (coast), 40 (internal), 45 (mountains) and, for 26 to 28 Oct, fresh to strong at times reaching 50 km/h with blowing dust.
limits: METAR reports whole knots as a 10 minute mean; the hourly sample is the report nearest to HH:00.
OMFJ, the east coast, fires two to six times as often as the west coast on the same numbers: set a station value if the console shows one point.

observed.source: METAR peak wind: the higher of the mean and a reported gust (Reported)

forecast.source: wind_gusts_10m, median of the usable models without gfs_seamless (Model forecast, Proposed)

thresholds.basis: A METAR gust is reported only when it passes the mean by 10 kt, so the observed peak understates the true gust (reported gusts are 0.20, 0.10 and 0.70 percent of reports at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ). The reanalysis gust is far higher than the METAR peak: the gust that fires on as many days as a METAR peak of 40 km/h is 53.6, 53.3, 46.8 km/h at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ, and for 50 km/h 56.5, 55.1, 54. So the forecast thresholds are 10 km/h above the observed ones. Observed peaks of 40 to 50 km/h carry dust: a dust code is reported in 39.7 percent of OMRK hours with a peak of 40 km/h or more against 0.66 percent of all hours.
limits: Only 73, 47 and 339 reported gusts in seven seasons at OMRK, OMSJ and OMFJ: the tail is thin. The record cannot say how a model gust of 60 km/h compares with what a person at the site feels.

Forecast models disagree on gust: over the last 92 days ecmwf_ifs025 has a median gust of 15 to 19 km/h, gem_seamless 6 to 9, gfs_seamless is below the wind. Take the median of the models without gfs_seamless and re check on the first season of recorded forecasts.

observed.watch: at 20:00 dew point spread 5 deg C or less (RH about 70 percent or more) at OMRK or OMSJ
observed.alert: between 02:00 and 08:00 RH 90 percent or more (spread 1 deg C or less) with wind 10 kt (19 km/h) or less

forecast.watch: the same on dew_point_2m and temperature_2m from ecmwf_ifs025 for the evening hour
forecast.alert: the fog ladder already in the engine (spread 1.0, 0.5, 0.25 deg C, wind 10 kt or less, 02:00 to 08:00); this record does not change it

thresholds.basis: Fog is a west coast event: in the Oct to Mar record there are 49 fog nights at OMRK, 62 at OMSJ and 3 at OMFJ (fog night: FG, or visibility of 1 km or less, between 02:00 and 09:00; the 3 at OMFJ are storms, not fog). At fog hours OMRK shows RH 94 percent or more in 95 percent of hours and spread 1 deg C or less in 90 percent; OMSJ 88 percent and 2 deg C. At 20:00 a spread of 5 deg C or less flags 376 of 1,241 OMRK nights and 42 of 49 fog nights (OMSJ needs 6 deg C: 49 of 62 fog nights).
thresholds.basisNightHours: Between 02:00 and 08:00 the rule RH 90 percent or more with wind 19 km/h or less (spread of 1 deg C or less) catches 96.8 percent of OMRK fog hours at a precision of 8.8 percent and 83.5 percent of OMSJ fog hours at a precision of 28.9 percent; RH 95 percent or more catches 66.9 and 39.2 percent at a precision of 16.9 and 69 percent.

limits: Fog is rare (4 to 5 percent of nights), so every watch flags 90 percent or more nights without fog: a watch means prone, not forecast.
METAR temperature and dew point are whole degrees: a spread of 0.5 deg C cannot be read from a station.
OMFJ has no FG hour in seven seasons (its 3 fog nights are storms): no threshold can be set for the east coast.
Model RH is 1 to 14 points off (meteofrance_seamless most): use the spread, not RH, on the forecast side.

forecast.source: median of the usable models (Model forecast, Proposed); best_match reads within 1 to 5 points of METAR on average

thresholds.basis: RH of 20 percent or less is 2.5, 2.1 and 1.8 percent of Oct to Mar hours at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ; 10 percent or less is 0.25, 0.26, 0.14. A reading band for dry air, not a trigger: dry and windy hours carry no more dust than windy hours (RH 25 percent or less and peak 25 km/h or more: dust in 8 of 96 OMRK hours, 8.3 percent, against 8.5 percent for a peak of 25 km/h or more alone).
limits: The record shows no hazard that dry air predicts in this plan. Heat and fire effects are outside the record.

observed.watch: daily minimum 10 deg C or less
observed.alert: daily minimum 8 deg C or less

forecast.source: median of the usable models; best_match is within 0.4 deg C of METAR on average at the west stations

thresholds.basis: Oct to Mar hours: 1st percentile 11, 13, 16 deg C and lowest 5, 7, 12 deg C at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ. A daily minimum of 10 deg C or less falls on 11.7, 2.9, 0 days a season, 8 deg C or less on 2.9, 0.57, 0.
limits: Cold matters only inland and on the west coast: OMFJ has 0 days at 10 deg C or less in seven seasons.

observed.watch: daily maximum 40 deg C or more
observed.alert: daily maximum 42 deg C or more
observed.source: METAR (Reported); valid for Oct to Mar only

forecast.source: median of the usable models; the archive daily maximum is 0.8 to 1.8 deg C off the METAR daily maximum (absolute)

thresholds.basis: In Oct to Mar a daily maximum of 40 deg C or more falls on 3.6, 2.1, 0.29 days a season and 42 deg C or more on 0.57, 0.29, 0; 45 deg C never. Over the whole year 2019 to 2026 the same station days are 40 deg C: 138, 116, 29.1 a year; 45 deg C: 19.4, 10.9, 4.1 a year.
limits: The Oct to Mar record cannot support a heat alert above 42 deg C. Summer heat belongs to the summer arrangements, owner HSE; this plan season does not test it.

observed.watch: fall of 4 hPa or more in 24 h, or a 3 h fall of 2 hPa or more after taking out the hour of day tide
observed.alert: fall of 6 hPa or more in 24 h, or a 3 h fall of 3 hPa or more after taking out the tide

forecast.watch: pressure_msl fall of 4 hPa or more over 24 h
forecast.source: median of the usable models (Model forecast, Proposed); pressure_msl is read within 0.3 to 0.8 hPa of METAR

thresholds.basis: The rule as asked, a fall of 3 hPa or more in 3 h, fires on 1,433, 1,429 and 1,308 hours at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ, 95.2, 96.3 and 96.3 percent of them between 13:00 and 15:00: it is the afternoon pressure tide (the mean 3 h change is about minus 2.5 hPa at 14:00 and plus 1.7 at 09:00), 125 episodes a season at OMRK, and rain follows within 6 h in 3.3 percent of them against 2.3 percent of all hours. Not usable. A 24 h fall of 4 hPa or more flags 10.7, 8.7, 9.3 episodes a season with rain within 12 h in 15.9, 20.9, 23.9 percent of flagged hours (base 3.4, 4.7, 5.5 percent); 6 hPa or more flags 1.7, 1.1, 0.86 episodes with rain in 26, 32, 29.7 percent.
limits: A fall is a supporting reading: 88, 87 and 85 percent of the episodes of a 24 h fall of 4 hPa (OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ) are not followed by rain within 12 h, so it raises attention and never sets a stage alone.
Pressure is whole hPa, so a tide adjusted 3 h fall moves in steps of 0.5 hPa.
The heaviest spell on the register (21 to 27 Mar 2026) falls in the 50 day hole of the IEM record, so no threshold here was tested on it.

thresholds.parameter: dust (CAMS dust at 10 m, ug/m3) checked against observed dust hours

observed.watch: a dust code (DU, BLDU, DRDU, DS, SS) in a METAR, or visibility under 5,000 m with no fog, mist or rain
observed.alert: a dust code with visibility under 3,000 m, or dust and a peak wind of 40 km/h or more at the same station
observed.source: METAR (Reported); a quarter of the dust hours on record at OMRK had visibility of 2,993 m or less

forecast.alert: dust 500 ug/m3 or more (or pm10 300 ug/m3 or more)
forecast.source: Open-Meteo air quality, CAMS (Model forecast, Proposed)

thresholds.basis: CAMS dust has a high background: median 42, 43, 36 ug/m3 and 99th percentile 347, 434, 305 ug/m3 in Oct to Mar at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ, while the dust hours the airports reported sit at a median of 67, 121, 75. A level of 300 ug/m3 is reached in 1.6, 3.9, 1.1 percent of hours and gives 12.3, 31.1, 9.0 alarm episodes a season; 500 ug/m3 gives 3.1, 4.3, 1.8. Of the observed dust episodes since Aug 2022 (10, 21, 26 in Oct to Mar) the alert level catches 3, 4, 2; of the alarm episodes at 500 ug/m3 75, 76.5, 71.4 percent had no observed dust within 6 h. pm10 of 300 ug/m3 does better at OMRK (1.5 episodes a season, 50 percent without dust, 3 of 10 episodes caught).
limits: The CAMS record starts on 4 Aug 2022: three full Oct to Mar seasons and Oct 2026. Observed dust episodes in that time are few (10 at OMRK, 21 at OMSJ, 26 at OMFJ), so recall figures move by several points with one episode.

CAMS dust cannot separate the dust hours the airports reported from its own background: the record supports it only as a tail signal. The better dust signals are the observed ones: a peak wind of 40 km/h or more carries a dust code in 39.7, 23.2 and 18.4 percent of hours at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ against 0.66, 0.55, 1.2 percent of all hours.
The 8 rain points give 5 distinct CAMS series (rakcity, burairat and khatt share one cell; alrams and jais another).

observed.alert: 1,000 m or less, or any FG, BCFG, MIFG, PRFG

forecast.source: model visibility has no skill (see the unusable list)

thresholds.basis: Visibility under 5,000 m is 5.2, 4.5 and 1.7 percent of Oct to Mar hours at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ and 1,000 m or less is 168, 143 and 6 hours in the Oct to Mar record. Same definitions as the fog record in calibration.json.
limits: METAR visibility is capped at 10 km (the text 6+ miles, or 9999): above that there is no reading, not a larger one.

thresholds.basis: The six models differ by a factor of 3 in the median (OMRK, Jul to Oct: ecmwf_ifs025 3,150, ukmo_seamless 3,495, gfs_seamless 1,170, meteofrance_seamless 0 J/kg) and three exceed 8,000 J/kg. At the 6 thunder hours at OMFJ in the 92 days best_match shows 3,635 J/kg against a median of 3,500 for all hours; OMRK and OMSJ had no thunder hour in that time.
limits: Use model rain, not CAPE, for convective risk until a season of recorded forecasts and gauge data exists.

cannotSupport: A rule of 3 hPa in 3 h: the raw fall is the daily pressure tide (95.2, 96.3 and 96.3 percent of the hours with that fall, at OMRK, OMSJ and OMFJ, are at 13:00 to 15:00 local). Only the tide adjusted fall or the 24 h fall carries a rain signal, and a weak one.
Any CAPE threshold in J/kg: the models disagree by a factor of 3, one reads about zero, and the thunder hours on record show no rise in CAPE.
A model visibility trigger: no usable skill (7 of 85 low visibility hours found at OMRK; gfs_seamless stays at 24.1 km).

A gust threshold validated against METAR: only 0.1 to 0.7 percent of reports carry a gust, and a model gust is not that quantity. The forecast gust values are carried over from the reanalysis and need a season of recorded forecasts.
A CAMS dust threshold that separates the dust hours the airports reported: the dust alert level catches 3 of 10 (OMRK), 4 of 21 (OMSJ) and 2 of 26 (OMFJ) observed Oct to Mar episodes since Aug 2022.
Fog levels for the east coast: OMFJ has no FG hour in seven seasons (6 hours at 1 km or less, all in storms or heavy rain).
A heat alert above 42 deg C in the plan season: the record has no Oct to Mar day at 45 deg C (whole year: 19 days a year at OMRK).
Anything about the 21 to 27 Mar 2026 spell from stations: the IEM record has no observation from 4 Mar to 23 Apr 2026.
Any rain gauge threshold: no rain gauge register is on file (Wet Utilities with NCM); METAR present weather is the only observed rain.
readingRules: null stays null: a value the API returns as null is no reading, never 0 and never calm.
METAR gust absent: no gust reported (not calm, not zero). METAR wind direction VRB or M: variable or calm, show the word.
METAR visibility 6+ miles or 9999: 10 km or more (a cap), not a measurement of 10 km.
IEM gust M, mslp M, skyc1 M: no value in the report; pressure is taken from the Q group.
A model that returns no value for a variable (visibility, uv_index, soil moisture) is left out of the band, not counted as zero.
Times are Asia/Dubai (UTC+4); utc_offset_seconds 14400 must be present or the point is unread.

gaps.gap: IEM record hole 4 Mar to 23 Apr 2026 at OMRK, OMSJ, OMFJ
gaps.owner: IEM archive, upstream the airport weather offices through NCM

gaps.gap: NCM automatic station observations (token gated page)
Forecast gust against a gust measured at site
gaps.owner: Wet Utilities with NCM; the ledger of recorded forecasts closes it after one season

gaps.gap: Sea state check against NCM wording (slight to moderate against 0.2 to 0.5 m)
Heat thresholds outside Oct to Mar

unusable: visibility from ecmwf_ifs025, icon_seamless, gem_seamless and meteofrance_seamless: no value at any hour. gfs_seamless: 24.1 km at every hour (24,120 to 24,140 m). ukmo_seamless: never under 5 km (highest 17 km). best_match found 7 of 85 METAR hours under 5 km at OMRK.
gfs_seamless wind_gusts_10m: under its own wind speed in 58 percent of hours at the 8 points and under the METAR mean wind in 32 to 70 percent of hours at the three stations.

CAPE as a threshold in J/kg: median 2,460 J/kg at OMRK in best_match against 3,150 in ecmwf_ifs025, 1,170 in gfs_seamless and 0 in meteofrance_seamless; ukmo_seamless reaches 13,610, ecmwf_ifs025 9,150, best_match 8,750 J/kg in 92 days; the 6 thunder hours at OMFJ show no rise.

meteofrance_seamless relative_humidity_2m and dew_point_2m: humidity 14 to 17 points low at OMRK and OMFJ, dew point 3 to 4 deg C dry; the model also ends on 28 Oct 22:00 and has no precipitation_probability.
soil_moisture_0_to_7cm (best_match, ecmwf_ifs025 only), uv_index and uv_index_max (best_match, gfs_seamless only): no band.
A fall of 3 hPa in 3 h on raw METAR pressure: the afternoon pressure tide.
IEM mslp: empty in every row at all three stations. IEM gust: empty in 99.4 to 99.9 percent of rows because no gust was reported, not because the reading is lost.
aviationweather.gov for more than 168 hours at a station: the call is cut at 400 reports (hours 336 and 720 return the same 400).
NCM automatic station observations (26 stations in the area): token gated page, not read.
METAR gust as a check on a model gust: 0.1 to 0.7 percent of reports carry one.
